nodes.text: Growth, customers and the team, and the moments that tested us along the way.
start with the hard parts, page six, if you like
Second consecutive year above plan, with services now a fifth of the mix.
Three of the ten largest arrived through partners.
Two new offices, one of them our first outside the country.
Highest on record; the support rebuild paid for itself by August.
every figure here is in the accounts, page 31 onward
Software carried the first half; services, a fifth of the mix by December, carried the second.
Services revenue, a fifth of the mix
every quarter beat the one before it, a first for us
Four quarters, four things that changed the company.
Every month of the year, and the four that changed the company.
Six months of rebuild shipped in one week, with no customer downtime.
Our first team outside the country, twenty-two people by year end.
Forty partners signed; a third of new customers now arrive through them.
An enterprise seat, signed on a call that started as a support ticket.
not on this strip: the outage. It has its own page.
Nine hours, four hundred customers affected
Root cause in a vendor we had not audited
A named on-call owner for each service
Elena called both customers who left, herself
They told us what broke, what they were doing about it, and when it would be fixed. That is why we stayed.
Brightline renewed for three years in January
Set the plan and kept every promise in it.
Opened Lisbon and built the partner programme.
Led the relaunch and the platform team.
Rebuilt support and won back the trust.
and the 182 people who are not on this page
Three markets, one new product line, and the same promise: tell the truth early.
questions to Elena, any time before the AGM
